test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.
solution:
The erroneous spelling is** 'condencing'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 
 
Contradiction:

 
 
• "Contradiction" is correctly spelled. It refers to a statement or proposition that opposes or denies another or itself and is logically incongruous.
 
 
 
• 
 
Abhorrent:

 
 
• "Abhorrent" is correctly spelled. It describes something that is repugnant; detestable.
 
 
 
• 
 
Condencing:

 
 
• "Condencing" doesn't actually exist in the English language. The correct spelling seems to be "Condensing" which refers to the action of making something more compact or concentrated.
 
 
 
• 
 
Hereditary:

 
 
• "Hereditary" is correctly spelled. It refers to a trait, characteristic, or condition determined by genetics and therefore able to be passed on from parents to their offspring or descendants.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer **"Option 3".**
